questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how failures propagate from the database layer up to the HTTP response? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
Between findById and tickets.assign, another request deletes the ticket. What does the client receive?
choices: 200 with the ticket showing the new assignee

questions.prompt: The agent directory call rejects because the directory service is down. What happens to the request?
choices: The ticket is assigned anyway because the check is skipped
The rejection propagates to next(err) and the client gets 500 'internal error'
The client gets 409 'agent cannot take tickets'
The request hangs because the rejection is unhandled

questions.prompt: Why does the error handler only send err.message to the client when status is below 500?
choices: To avoid leaking internal details such as SQL or hostnames from unexpected errors
Because Express cannot serialise messages of 5xx errors
So that clients retry 4xx errors automatically
